Fit a tank/fish nested longitudinal model using established nlme

Source: R/hierarchical-event-model.R
aqt_hierarchical_event_fit.Rd

Fits a simple Gaussian linear mixed-effects model with treatment, epoch and their interaction as fixed effects plus nested random intercepts for independent tanks and fish within tank. This is not automatic causal identification, nor does it model heteroscedasticity, autocorrelation, calibration errors or identity uncertainty. Report singularity/convergence, treatment replication and residual diagnostics.

Usage

aqt_hierarchical_event_fit(prepared, method = c("REML", "ML"))

Arguments

prepared

Data from aqt_hierarchical_event_prepare().

method

"REML" (default) or "ML".

Value

List containing native nlme fit and a design audit.
